title: Antistreptolysin O (ASO)
what: This blood test looks for antibodies to strep bacteria. It shows whether you had a recent strep infection.
why: For painful, swollen joints, for changes in urine tests or the heart after strep throat, and for frequent strep throat.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: If you recently had strep throat, scarlet fever, or a sore throat
If your joints hurt or your face is swollen
If your ASO was high before

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast strictly, but it is better to come 3 to 4 hours after a light, non-fatty meal. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours: no alcohol and no hard workouts. Try not to smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything needs to change before the test.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
Your urine test, if you had one
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
ASO does not rise right after strep throat. Sometimes the test is repeated after a few weeks
A high ASO with no symptoms is usually not treated. Your doctor decides
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red
Swelling, dark cola-colored urine, or shortness of breath after strep throat: see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Does a high ASO mean rheumatic fever?
faq.a: No. It only shows you had strep recently. The doctor makes a diagnosis based on everything.

faq.q: Do I need antibiotics if my ASO is high?
faq.a: Not always. Your doctor decides. Do not start antibiotics on your own.

reminders.text: ASO test tomorrow. Better to skip fatty food in the morning.
